lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 5 distinct vertical lines are visible on the lateral torso. One continuous high-contrast line is located in the mid-section, followed by 4 increasingly fragmented and irregularly spaced lines towards the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Multiple line segments on the posterior half of the torso are discontinuous, appearing as dashed marks that fail to reach the ventral or dorsal boundaries of the torso mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A high-contrast cluster of approximately 9 white spots is visible on the lower posterior haunch, concentrated above the hock.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A set of 4 spots on the posterior thigh align in a diagonal-horizontal row, forming a semi-connected geometric line.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns exhibit a spiral lyrate curvature, projecting dorsoposteriorly from the skull before twisting medially and then dorsally towards the terminal tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal horn tips is approximately 3.8 times the width of the individual horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory-colored tips represent approximately 10% of the total vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white chevron between the eyes, white spotting on the lower cheeks, and a prominent white horizontal band across the lower neck.
